survivors.original: if not line or line[0] not in valid_package_start_chars:
survivors.replacement: if not line or line[-1] not in valid_package_start_chars:
survivors.description: Checks the last character instead of the first, wrongly skipping valid requirements that end in a non-alphanumeric character (e.g. a trailing extras bracket or a quote).
survivors.diff:
--- a/charmcraft/utils/package.py
+++ b/charmcraft/utils/package.py
@@ -38,3 +38,3 @@
             line = line.strip()
-            if not line or line[0] not in valid_package_start_chars:
+            if not line or line[-1] not in valid_package_start_chars:
                 continue
survivors.words: charmcraft/utils/package.py:39: changing `            if not line or line[0] not in valid_package_star...` to `            if not line or line[-1] not in valid_package_sta...` made no test fail; no input tried behaved differently from the fix (it may be equivalent)
